text: The Patriots pulled off one of the most crucial comebacks of Week 4, storming back from what looked like a disastrous 1-3 start to upset the Bills 29-26 at Buffalo's new Highmark Stadium—a victory that made them the first team to win in the venue and that coach Mike Vrabel characterized as critical for the defending AFC East champions' season trajectory. Drake Maye, who had struggled early in the year and committed two turnovers in the contest, orchestrated a game-winning drive and threw three touchdown passes to shake off his rough start and prove he could deliver in clutch moments against a talented Buffalo roster led by Josh Allen. The win elevated the Patriots to 2-2 alongside the Rams and Cowboys, all three teams having staged dramatic Week 4 rallies after staring down the prospect of falling to 1-3, though whether these comebacks signal genuine course corrections or represent overreactions to a single week remains an open question among analysts parsing the NFL's latest chaos.
